_note: Rebuilt draft from the project brief. Sources and effective dates are NOT verified yet. last_checked is deliberately old so the app shows 'Compliance rules need re-checking' until a human verifies them.

rules.rule: Every promotional caption must carry the project's RERA registration number.
rules.check: caption contains the RERA number from the brochure

rules.rule: Caption must include the Karnataka RERA website.
Every number in a script must match the brochure facts. The developer is liable for false claims.
rules.check: every number appears in the extracted facts

rules.rule: A video made with an AI presenter must visibly say it is AI-generated.
Use a stock avatar only. Do not copy a real person's face or voice without consent.
The AI label should stay visible for the whole video.
Karnataka RERA may expect the project QR code in promotional material.
Do not promise returns or appreciation.
rules.check: flag phrases like 'guaranteed returns', 'assured appreciation', 'double your money'
rules.source_name: RERA Act 2016, Section 12 and advertising standards
